SafePace est le podcast running et sport: SafePace is Hugo Clément's running and endurance sports podcast. Each episode invites champions, experts and celebrities — Ophélie Meunier, Gilles Bouleau, ultra-trail runners, sports doctors — to talk about their relationship with effort, pain and pushing their limits. Running, ultra-trail, triathlon, nutrition, doping, school sport: the topics are varied and the production polished.
Le podcast de Hugo Clément dédié aux spo: Hugo Clément's podcast devoted to endurance sports: running, ultra-trail, triathlon. Every week, experts, champions and celebrities (Ophélie Meunier, Gilles Bouleau…) share their relationship with effort. Polished production, varied topics — from doping to school sport to runners' nutrition. Our verdict: excellent, but with an "insiders" side that can put off newcomers. You'll have to get past the technical vocabulary to fully enter this world. Once you're in, you won't want to leave.
